_comment: smart-trust-demo pins the layers smart-trust-tools pins (fhir-harness and everything below it), unchanged, and smart-trust-tools itself, whose req: nodes, skills and actors the journeys name. The mounts are laid down from index.lock.json and gitignored. The site is agent-run.
